💡 الفرق بين يوم التأسيس واليوم الوطني با: 💡 The difference between Founding Day and National Day in Saudi Arabia
يوم التأسيس (22 فبراير) عطلة رسمية فقط م: Founding Day (22 February) has been an official holiday only since 2022, and commemorates the founding of the first Saudi state in 1727 by Imam Muhammad bin Saud — more than two centuries before the modern Kingdom was established. National Day (23 September) is completely different: it commemorates the unification of the Kingdom in 1932 by King Abdulaziz.
من أصل العطل الرسمية الأربع، اثنتان فقط: Of the four official holidays, only two are Hijri (Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha) and they move earlier by about 11 days each Gregorian year, while Founding Day and National Day are fixed in the Gregorian calendar and do not change. For planning: government offices and banks usually close on official holidays, so plan your appointments and travel in advance, especially around the long Eid periods.
لماذا يوم التأسيس عطلة رسمية حديثة نسبيا: Why is Founding Day a relatively recent official holiday?
لأنه رسمي فقط من 2022 رغم أنه يوثّق حدث: Because it has been official only since 2022 even though it commemorates a historical event from 1727 — unlike National Day, which became an official holiday much earlier and commemorates the unification of the Kingdom in 1932.
